candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The ratio u/U is dimensionless by construction (velocity divided by same velocity). Using U (velocity), nu (kinematic viscosity), x (length), and y (length), the only required dimensional assignments are the standard SI base exponents for each input: U has dimensions L T^-1, nu has L^2 T^-1, and x and y are lengths L.
